status: literature-informed reconstruction; not recovered author experiment settings

architecture.name: bilstmattention
architecture.note: PyTorch port of author model definitions; PyTorch NAdam optimizer. Task dimensions adapt complete sensor-triplet branch count and attention length; exact UCI reference geometry is128x9 with6classes.

training.note: Reference150-epoch horizon and PyTorch NAdam; source-validation Macro-F1 replaces official-test validation accuracy.

split_seed.reason: Seeded person cycle for clarified LOSO; fixed 80/20 source split for LODO. Exact original membership unpublished.

synthetic.note: Counts, ratios and prompt text are reconstruction choices; generator internals remain upstream-owned.

upstream_generators.note: The supplied paper's MCP deployment is not published. This project implements an IMUGPT stdio server against official revision 4b7a73fa7c8b6fdbd18a389b902c0d935a77fc4f, using categorical T2M-GPT motion sampling, skeleton IK, and ideal IMUSim acceleration/gyroscope channels at 50 Hz. Owner-configured sensor placement, channel mapping, pretrained assets and a separate CUDA environment are required. Real model generation remains unverified. IMUTube requires official access: contact its original authors.

user_clarifications.loso: One test person, next distinct person in a seeded cyclic order for validation, all remaining people train. Cycle every person once in each held-out role. Overrides the paper source-validation fraction for LOSO.

baseline_selection.criterion: Highest equally weighted mean of real-only LOSO Macro-F1 columns in supplied paper Table 2; fixed literature-informed choice, not an empirical claim for new folds.
baseline_selection.scope: Literature rationale for the explicit BiLSTM-Attention template, not automatic dataset-specific selection.

configuration_scope: This file documents the explicit examples/baseline.json reference template. Automatic search initialization uses research/baseline_registry.json and source-validation selection.
